QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] The Last Call
QuestInfo.0: The student from the other world now wants to return to where he came from. Talk to Lily to sort out the situation.
QuestInfo.1: To return things to where they were, Lily says she needs to erase memories of you from everybody. Call one of your friends for the very last time... before they forget all about you.
QuestInfo.2: The last call ended. It's hard to believe, but you'll be forgotten from everybody forever...

default.0: Call one of your friends for the very last time.\r\n#b(Open the smartphone to call one of your friends.)#k
